title: Jesse Minter: Diego Pavia was a "force multiplier" at Vanderbilt, will come in with a clean slate

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jesse Minter: Diego Pavia was a "force multiplier" at Vanderbilt, will come in with a clean slate
sources.description: After it was first reported that former Vanderbilt quarterback Diego Pavia had accepted an invitation to Ravens rookie minicamp, it was then revealed on Tuesday that the signal-caller would actually be signing with the club as an undrafted free agent.
